diagnoses.description:
No required workbook population occurred; the agent only inspected the template instead of entering/linking data and formulas needed for the HP filter, projections, and production function steps.
Evidence: The agent found “Production formulas 0 ... WEO_Data formulas 0” (turn 48) and that most rows were empty (turn 49 shows rows 28–34 all None, with only headers like “K/Y”, “K”, “Y”, etc. in row 35).
Trajectory location: turns 47–49

The agent followed a command-line data acquisition/debugging approach rather than executing the specified Excel-only workflow (including Solver-based HP filter) and Playwright-based WEO extraction.
Evidence: The task requires “ONLY use excel” and “Use Playwright MCP” for IMF WEO; however actions used terminal curl/python/openpyxl and there are no Playwright tool calls or Excel/Solver operations shown in this window.
Trajectory location: turns 46–60

Incorrect sheet selection/assumption about where the main dataset resides (the dataset is in the “Data” sheet, not the first sheet).
Evidence: The agent attempted to read headers from the first sheet of PWT (“Info”) and failed: “ValueError: 'countrycode' is not in list”.
Trajectory location: turn 52

Inefficient access pattern (random-access ws.cell calls over a very large read-only sheet) caused slow streaming XML parsing; needed iter_rows(values_only=True) to be performant (which was used successfully in turn 58).
Evidence: Parsing the PWT Data sheet with cell-based access stalled (“Process still running (soft timeout)”), requiring an interrupt (turn 57 shows KeyboardInterrupt inside openpyxl read-only parsing).
Trajectory location: turns 53–57

Investment path values appear inconsistent with the task’s total-shock constraint and/or with workbook unit conventions (USD vs millions), but no reconciliation or Excel-based implementation followed.
Evidence: The agent summed an 8-year investment schedule to 10583.8 (units unclear), which contradicts the stated total “6.5 billion USD” investment lasting 8 years.
Trajectory location: turn 50

The agent stopped at URL discovery and shifted to PWT exploration; the core dependency (WEO real GDP level and growth for 2000–2027 and extension to 2043) remained unfulfilled.
Evidence: Although WEO .xls URLs were discovered (turn 46), no subsequent download/parsing of the WEO file and no population of the “WEO_Data” sheet occurred (earlier summary notes WEO_Data numeric rows count = 0 and nothing in this window contradicts that).
Trajectory location: turns 46–60
